description: The complete YouGame SDK reference: desktop/mobile button positions and reserved screen areas, touch controls, leaderboards (gameOver / submitScore), beat-my-score links, saves (save / load, kept on the player's account), online multiplayer with matchmaking, friend invites, skill ratings, voice chat between friends that a game with a map can turn into proximity chat (YouGame.voice), persistent worlds (shared state kept between visits; not a game server), replays (YouGame.replay: record the game's state frame by frame, play it back with pause and seek, watch links; input recording for deterministic games). One script tag, no account needed. The whole reference is long: pass section (a heading such as "Multiplayer" or "Native builds") for just that part; an unknown section answers with the list of headings.

section.description: Optional: one heading of the reference, or words from it. Omit for the whole reference.
